need: Keep the repository's most visible writing clear, credible, and interesting without making a model or a bespoke prose engine authoritative.

discovery.stop_condition: A mature deterministic tool covered repeatable wording checks, while small review-only techniques covered first-impression and AI-pattern judgment without entering runtime behavior.

contenders.name: Vale 3.21.0 and vale-action 3.0.0
evidence: 6108 and 249 GitHub stars respectively at 2026-09-17 review

contenders.name: First Reader in Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps at f163bb5a92111cee4610ac98e5dce4c6a2a09c26
evidence: fresh-reader quick skim separates first impression from editorial context
parent repository is a broad learning collection rather than a blanket dependency endorsement

contenders.name: ZeroSlop 2.12.1
evidence: offline scorer is explicitly heuristic and not an authorship detector

contenders.name: reader-first-writing-skills
evidence: one GitHub star and no stable release at 2026-09-17 review

contenders.name: custom prose scorer or model-only rewrite gate
evidence: risk of changing factual meaning and repository voice

hard_gates: runtime and canonical state remain model-free
automated prose checks are deterministic and offline
rules target a small public entrypoint set rather than generated upstream descriptions
human review remains responsible for meaning, evidence, and final tone
AI-pattern scores never become authorship claims or release thresholds
hosted rewriting services receive no unpublished repository prose
unknowns: First-impression judgments vary by reader and cannot be reduced to a score.
Project-owned Vale rules need evidence-based refinement as the public voice evolves.
Young AI-tone tools may mature enough to justify a later bounded trial.
decision_effect: Use Vale 3.21.0 with a pinned official action and narrow local rules for repeatable public-copy checks. Require a context-free first-reader skim for material entrypoint changes. Keep First Reader and ZeroSlop as optional review techniques only; neither can author facts, gate releases by score, or enter the runtime dependency graph.
reconsider_when: Vale rules create repeated false positives or miss a measured public-writing failure
A mature offline tool demonstrates better reader-journey checks with a clear removal boundary
The public entrypoint set or documentation generator changes materially
AI-assisted editing can no longer preserve an inspectable human approval boundary
